title: The stock muonic cascade of Geant4: the comparison with measured K-series intensities and the test of the compiled cascade
about: The comparison rule of the muonic X-ray cascade section of BENCHMARK_STOPPED_MU.md and the test of the cascades harvested from the stopped-muon application, read by openmucf/g4/capture_cascade.py through scripts/generate_stopped_mu.py and by the cascade command of cpp/stopped_muon/stopped_muon.py.

model.quantity: the expected number of each transition per stopped muon of the branching rules of G4EmCaptureCascade::ApplyYourself (third_party/geant4/v11.4.2/G4EmCaptureCascade.cc; the rule statements of v11.5.0.beta are the same once whitespace is removed), with G4UniformRand taken as a continuous uniform draw, computed in exact rational arithmetic
model.depends_on: Z alone: the rules read no mass number, phase or chemistry
model.domain: Z from 1 to 215, over which the 32-bit integer product Z*Z*Z*Z does not overflow
model.uncertainty: none: the compared value is the exact expectation of the code, not a prediction with an error

observables.high_over_ka: the photons n->1 summed over n >= k, over photons 2->1, with k the lowest n of the source's grouped member
observables.ka_over_ktot: photons 2->1 over the photons n->1 summed over n = 2..14 (the k_normalised part)

ratios.measured: printed_ratio_percent: the printed intensity relative to 2->1, divided by 100, with its printed error; absolute_members: the ratio of the two printed members
ratios.sigma_two_member: sigma_r^2 = r^2 ((sigma_a/a)^2 + (sigma_b/b)^2): the two published errors independent
ratios.decision: HOLDS iff (m - d)^2 <= 4 sigma^2; TENSION iff 4 sigma^2 < (m - d)^2 <= 9 sigma^2; FAILS otherwise; decided on squares in exact arithmetic from the decimal strings; the pull (m - d)/sigma is printed to 2 decimals and decides nothing
ratios.counts: per (source, observable), the condensed-phase rows (primary) and the gas rows (secondary) reported apart, never pooled across sources
ratios.correlation_scan: for a ratio of two published members, the verdicts at correlation -1 and +1 between their errors (sigma^2 is linear in the correlation, so they are the extremes); a report that decides no verdict, written after the ratio pulls had been seen

k_normalised.measured: member 2->1 over the sum of the printed members of the same source
k_normalised.sigma: sigma(K alpha) / sum, the sum held fixed (the convention that decides the verdict); beside it, sigma, pull and verdict under independent propagation of every member, which decide nothing

harvest.seeds: event i of every cell is seeded with seed_base + i, i < events: outside the seeds of the benchmark's cells (8675309 + i, i < 1410959, the largest events_total of cells.jsonl)
harvest.run: one run per cell with the pre-registration's harness options, environment and dataset binding; the DATASET lines checked before and after the run as the run command checks them
harvest.every_event: one stopped muon whose cascade reconstructs under the Auger cap; any other event refuses the cell
harvest.retained_counts: every transition the rules allow (a photon from level n to each lower level and an Auger electron from n to n - 1, for n = 2..14) and the numbers of stops entering 1s by a photon from n >= 6, >= 7 and >= 8
harvest.decision: for each retained count x with model probability p, the tail on x's side of the mode floor((N + 1) p): P(X >= x) above it, P(X <= x) below it; x at the mode passes; reject iff a certified upper bound of that tail is <= budget_per_cell / (retained counts x sides); a cell passes iff no count rejects
harvest.family: P(false alarm) <= budget_per_cell per cell (Bonferroni over its counts) and <= 14 x budget_per_cell over the cells (union bound); no independence is assumed

drills.kb_shift_means: stops moved from photon 2->1 to photon 3->1 in a fixture of rounded expectations
drills.intra_shift_means: stops moved from photon 5->1 to an entry into 1s from n >= 8 in the same fixture
drills.photon_weight_drill_means: the real counts tested against the model with photon weight 9, which must reject every cell

fixed.relation_to_data: before the verified-data comparison was computed; preliminary Orth pulls had already been seen
fixed.contents: K beta / K alpha and (n >= k) / K alpha of every source: the model value, the measured ratio and its sigma, the bands at 2 and 3 sigma, the condensed rows primary and the gas rows secondary, and k matched to each source's grouping

fixed.relation_to_data: fixed after data: after every pull of the ratios had been seen
fixed.contents: the comparison of K alpha / the sum of the printed members of ENSDF and Kirch et al. with the stock K alpha / K total, sigma(K alpha) / sum with the sum held fixed, and the independent propagation beside it
the cells, the events and seeds, the retained counts, the budget, the decision and the drill shifts

seen_before_fixing.seen: pulls of the stock cascade against values of Orth et al.'s Table I read by an unverified automated extraction, among them carbon K beta / K alpha -11.0 and aluminium (n >= 8) / K alpha +28.2
every pull of the ratio rows
the model alone: its expected counts and the certified power of the drills; no harvested count
